fact: Vedra 和 Daley 在 High Oak Camp 住了约一星期（sennight）后，Diarban 来传 Flann 的召见。
anchor: after she and Daley had spent about a sennight in High Oak Camp

fact: Flann 宣布次日黎明出发去 Crannhyr，带 Vedra、Daley、Mearna、Diarban 与 Ivar。
anchor: We set out tomorrow at dawn. Vedra here, who knows more about the parchment and ring

fact: Tynon 是 Flann 的“战团长”，此行留守 High Oak Camp，他反对这趟 Crannhyr 之行。
anchor: My war chieftain, as it were. He will be in charge of High Oak Camp

fact: Mearna 说 Ivar 在除一件事之外的所有方面都算 Flann 的老伴儿，Flann 只喜欢大块头男人。
anchor: In all ways but one, they are an old married couple

fact: 下山途中 Vedra 的脚卡在路边一块与她等高的巨石与硬土之间，Flann 用背和脚顶开石头救她。
anchor: her foot lodged between the rock and the hard soil at the side of the path

fact: 他们黄昏下到 Crannhyr，沿主街走到海神 Lirr 的盐渍木庙对面，拐上陡窄上坡路。
anchor: Across from a salt-crusted wooden temple dedicated to the sea god Lirr

fact: 山下城里只见两三点灯火，她担心这么小的地方找不到落脚处又不引人注意。
anchor: Two or three lights, anyway, and her heart sank

fact: 山顶宅邸门自开，白衣长者说此地被他命名为 Carn Gobach（Threadbare Hall），Flann 称他 Lord Xaniko。
anchor: Come in—you are welcome to Carn Gobach, as I have named it—Threadbare Hall
